<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wpdb;

// The perf probe rides along as an mu-plugin, the same file the VPS runs.
@mkdir( '/wordpress/wp-content/mu-plugins', 0777, true );
copy(
    '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/vergelabs-media-library/tests/perf/mu-perf.php',
    '/wordpress/wp-content/mu-plugins/mu-perf.php'
);

// 200 folders and 1000 files. Smaller than the VPS seed on purpose: the point is
// the query COUNT, which does not move with row count, so there is no reason to
// make SQLite grind through 20k inserts to learn the same integer.
$tt = array();
for ( $i = 0; $i < 200; $i++ ) {
    $t = wp_insert_term( 'Folder ' . $i, 'media_category', array( 'slug' => 'folder-' . $i ) );
    if ( ! is_wp_error( $t ) ) {
        $tt[] = (int) $t['term_id'];
    }
}

// Give folders 20..199 a parent, so the tree is genuinely nested like the VPS one.
foreach ( array_slice( $tt, 20 ) as $n => $id ) {
    wp_update_term( $id, 'media_category', array( 'parent' => $tt[ $n % 20 ] ) );
}

$now = current_time( 'mysql' );
for ( $i = 0; $i < 1000; $i++ ) {
    $wpdb->insert( $wpdb->posts, array(
        'post_author'    => 1,
        'post_date'      => $now,
        'post_date_gmt'  => $now,
        'post_title'     => 'image-' . $i,
        'post_name'      => 'image-' . $i,
        'post_status'    => 'inherit',
        'post_type'      => 'attachment',
        'post_mime_type' => 'image/jpeg',
        'guid'           => 'http://x/wp-content/uploads/image-' . $i . '.jpg',
        'post_content'   => '',
        'post_excerpt'   => '',
        'to_ping'        => '',
        'pinged'         => '',
        'post_content_filtered' => '',
    ) );
    $id = (int) $wpdb->insert_id;
    // 80% filed, 20% left loose -- same ratio as the VPS, so 'unassigned' has work to do.
    if ( $i % 5 !== 0 ) {
        wp_set_object_terms( $id, array( $tt[ $i % 200 ] ), 'media_category' );
    }
}

wp_update_term_count_now( wp_list_pluck( get_terms( array( 'taxonomy' => 'media_category', 'hide_empty' => false ) ), 'term_taxonomy_id' ), 'media_category' );

// Application passwords, so the benchmark needs no browser and no nonce.
// Test box only, and it never leaves the mu-plugins folder.
file_put_contents( '/wordpress/wp-content/mu-plugins/mu-bench-auth.php', "<?php
add_filter( 'wp_is_application_passwords_available', '__return_true' );
" );

$uid = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' )->ID;
update_user_meta( $uid, '_application_passwords', array( array(
    'uuid'      => wp_generate_uuid4(),
    'app_id'    => '',
    'name'      => 'bench',
    'password'  => function_exists( 'wp_fast_hash' ) ? wp_fast_hash( 'benchbenchbenchbench' ) : wp_hash_password( 'benchbenchbenchbench' ),
    'created'   => time(),
    'last_used' => null,
    'last_ip'   => null,
) ) );
